sharedBrief: Create ONE new themed illustration from the supplied original SHICI mint book mascot. This is part of a tightly consistent website illustration family, not a new character design. Lock the same thick rounded mint-green upright book cover, cream-white visible page block, yellow bookmark emerging from the top-left, two glossy black oval eyes and the same small warm smile, white mitten hands and short white legs, coral-orange rounded sneakers. Preserve body proportions, face placement, clay/plastic finish, soft upper-left studio lighting, subtle material grain, and the clean white die-cut sticker outline from the reference. Front three-quarter angle with the left page edge visible, matching the reference. Full body and every prop entirely visible. Square 1024x1024 composition, mascot occupies about 80 percent of height, centered with consistent clean margins. Background MUST be uniform pure white #FFFFFF. NO transparency checkerboard, no scene, no colored background, no platform, no floating symbols, no text labels, no watermarks, no new clothing or animal traits, no second character. Keep the face clearly visible and the silhouette legible as a small 80px UI illustration. Only change the pose and the small meaningful task prop described below.

themes.reading: THEME: READING. Remove the pencil. The same friendly mascot holds a small open cream-colored book with a muted blue cover in both hands at lower-chest height, looking attentively toward it, with a gentle smile. The open book must stay below the eyes and not cover the mascot's identity. No letters or text printed on the prop. Keep the body facing the viewer in the same angle.
themes.words: THEME: VOCABULARY. Remove the pencil. The same mascot presents three small study flashcards fanned out in its hands below its face. The front cream-white card has ONLY the large legible letters Aa in dark forest green; the two cards behind it are pastel blue and muted yellow without text. Friendly attentive smile. Cards should not cover the eyes or take over the composition. Exactly the same character and materials.
themes.review: THEME: STUDY RECORD / REVIEW. The same mascot holds a small cream clipboard with a muted blue rim in its left hand and the canonical yellow pencil in its right hand. On the clipboard show one restrained green check mark and two simple short gray lines, no text, no numbers, no grades, no trophies. Clipboard is below the face; character looks satisfied but calm. The meaning is recording completed practice, not passing a test. Preserve the same book body, face, bookmark and shoes.
themes.insights: THEME: LEARNING INSIGHTS. Remove the pencil. The same mascot holds a small cream-white analysis board with a muted blue rim in one hand, below the face. On this board are exactly three simple rounded vertical bars in mint, pastel blue and muted coral of varying heights, with no numbers, labels, axes, arrows or claimed scores. In the other hand it holds a small blue-rimmed magnifying glass beside the board, not covering its face. Expression is curious and thoughtful but still the canonical smile. This is a decorative analytics illustration, not an actual data chart.
themes.organize: THEME: ORGANIZE / QUESTION LIBRARY. Remove the pencil. The same mascot neatly holds a small pastel-blue file folder at lower-chest height, with three cream-white sheets peeking out and one small yellow index tab. The folder has no words, logo, arrows or symbols. A calm welcoming smile. Keep both hands visible supporting the folder; no other props. Face, mint body, yellow top bookmark and coral sneakers exactly match the original.
themes.search: THEME: SEARCH / EMPTY STATE. Remove the pencil. The same mascot holds a small magnifying glass with a soft pastel-blue rim in one hand, positioned beside and slightly below its face, inspecting a tiny blank cream-white note held in the other hand. The face stays fully visible with the same warm, gently curious smile. No question marks, sad expressions, error symbols, text, numbers, or floating objects. Friendly neutral search state, not failure. Match original angle, lighting, proportions and materials.
